weekly.title: OpenAI Engineer, Who Is Charged With Planting Bug, Advised Saudis

weekly.title: Midterms Could Shift Focus of Epstein Abuse to Banks’ Role
weekly.summary: With an eye on retaking control of Congress, Democrats are introducing a bill that would hold banks accountable for their handling of Jeffrey Epstein’s finances.

weekly.title: What Is Starshield, SpaceX’s Military-Grade Satellite Internet Service Ukraine Relies On?
weekly.summary: For years, Ukraine’s armed forces have relied on satellite communication services developed by Elon Musk’s SpaceX. Recent restrictions have hampered its war effort.

weekly.title: Energy Dept. Issues Emergency Order Amid Above-Average Temperatures
weekly.summary: The order as a precaution allows grid operators to use backup generation this week. There were no widespread outages reported.

weekly.title: Albania rioters clash with police for Socialist government as European unrest spreads
weekly.summary: Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama vowed not to resign as protests in Tirana erupted for a third day, with police deploying tear gas and water cannons.

weekly.title: 'Not wanted': Irish hotel reportedly cancels 70 rooms reserved for antisemitism conference attendees
weekly.summary: Jewish Representative Council of Ireland chairman Maurice Cohen says a Dublin hotel rejected an antisemitism conference after its manager questioned IDF involvement.

weekly.summary: “The Colorful Life,” a 1907 work by the Russian painter Wassily Kandinsky, had been returned to the original owners’ heirs in 2023.

weekly.summary: Even as alarm grows over the risks, families are embracing bots and agents to tackle the spiraling administrative tasks of modern child rearing.

weekly.summary: Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele unveiled a plan to free up to half of 90,000 detainees arrested under the state of emergency targeting gangs.

weekly.title: Trump wishes Pope Leo speedy recovery after lung cancer diagnosis, speaks highly of pontiff's brother

weekly.title: Why Trump’s Russian Diesel Deal Is Unlikely to Lower Fuel Costs

weekly.summary: The U.S. military detected 378 cartel drone incursions along the Mexico border in 30 days, and experts warn cartels will continue to innovate.
